profile_text.body:
Krea is a San Francisco-based company that describes itself as offering what it calls "the world's most powerful creative AI suite," providing tools to generate, edit, and enhance images and videos. Its platform aggregates and surfaces a range of third-party AI models alongside its own infrastructure, giving users access to video and image generation capabilities through a single interface.

The company's primary product, Krea AI, is categorized as a real-time video generation and editing platform. Through it, users can access models from ByteDance, including Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 Mini, which support cinematic clips at up to 1080p with synchronized audio and frame animation, as well as Google's Veo and Gemini-based video models, Minimax's frontier video model rendering at 2K, and Alibaba's latest generation video model supporting clips up to 30 seconds. On the image side, the platform offers models including FLUX 3, a Qwen-based image model, and Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash Image model with support for up to 4K resolution. The site also references Muse Image, described as a model that searches the web for references and runs code to handle elements such as charts and QR codes.

No litigation, regulatory filings, or MCP registry entries are recorded in the held facts for Krea.
